metaDescription: Shop custom awards recognition with zipper for secure storage. Perfect for corporate gifts. Bulk orders available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: When you need awards that protect their contents, custom awards recognition with zipper offers a practical solution. Unlike open-style awards, these zippered cases keep certificates, medals, or plaques secure during transport and storage. Ideal for HR directors organizing annual employee recognition ceremonies or safety managers distributing service awards, these custom pieces can be debossed or screen-printed with your logo. Choose from leatherette or nylon options in various colors to match your brand.
heroAltText: Custom awards recognition with zipper featuring a leatherette case with debossed logo and gold zipper pull
